declarations.name: AuiSwitch
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI Switch: `<aui-switch>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(checked)]` without forms.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Visible label and accessible name; clicking it toggles the switch.

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the label; it remains the accessible name.

inputs.name: validationTiming
inputs.description: When a custom error message first appears; afterwards it updates live.

models.name: checked
models.description: The checked: `[(checked)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show a custom error now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error, for example a failed save; cleared when the user toggles.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial state and clear dirty/touched/submitted state.

accessibility.pattern: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch"> with a <label for> association (WAI-ARIA APG Switch).

limitations: No `required` or `validate` option: a switch is a setting, not a question. Use setCustomError to report a failed save.
No built-in on/off text inside the track; the label must describe the setting.
The track is 2.25rem by 1.25rem; the 24px minimum target is met by the row and the clickable label, not the track alone.
